rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a celebratory or entertainment-focused social party.

example.english: We’re having a party at home tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚我哋屋企有個派對。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 jau5 go3 paai3 deoi3

rows.note: Use this for an ordinary temporary group of people gathered for a shared activity, rather than a celebratory social party.

example.jyutping: go2 jat1 baan1 jan4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 haang4 saan1

rows.note: Use this for a party to a legal proceeding or contract.

example.english: Each party to the contract must sign personally.
example.traditional: 合約要由當事人親自簽名。
example.jyutping: hap6 joek3 jiu3 jau4 dong1 si6 jan4 can1 zi6 cim1 meng2

rows.note: Use this for a military detachment selected for a particular duty.

example.english: This party of soldiers was ordered to scout the area.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu2 deoi6 fung6 meng6 heoi3 zing1 caat3
